title: Complexity IT - AD (ICT) Complete Master Course
description: The comprehensive all-in-one preparation program for Assistant Director (AD) & ICT professional exams. Includes complete video lectures, notes, assignments, and solved question sets across C Programming, Data Structures, DBMS, Digital Logic Design, Computer Networks, Operating Systems, and Object-Oriented Programming (OOP).

lessons.title: Lecture 01: OOP Fundamentals: Classes, Objects, Methods & Encapsulation
lessons.description: Core concepts of Object-Oriented Programming: classes, objects, methods, constructors, state and behavior, encapsulation, and access modifiers.

lessons.title: Lecture 02: Constructors, Overloading & Memory Allocation
lessons.description: In-depth exploration of default, parameterized, and copy constructors, constructor chaining with this() and super(), and heap vs stack memory allocation.

lessons.title: Lecture 03: Polymorphism: Method Overloading & Runtime Method Overriding
lessons.description: Compile-time vs runtime polymorphism, dynamic method dispatch, virtual method tables, covariant return types, and exam problem solving.

lessons.title: Lecture 04: Abstraction, Abstract Classes & Multiple Interface Inheritance
lessons.description: Data abstraction principles, abstract classes vs interfaces, default and static methods in interfaces, and multiple inheritance resolution.

lessons.title: Lecture 05: Object Relationships: Association, Aggregation & Composition
lessons.description: Structural relationships between classes: Is-A vs Has-A relationships, tight coupling with composition, loose coupling with aggregation, and UML representation.

lessons.title: Lecture 06: Multithreading & Concurrency in Java
lessons.description: Thread lifecycle, Thread class vs Runnable interface, thread synchronization, race conditions, deadlock prevention, and concurrent execution.
